task.title: Triage collection-header-kebab e2e failures: New-binder-inside gets parent_id null; Move-to descendant filter
task.description:
Found 2026-08-11 while running the collection e2e specs for P6-068 (failures reproduced identically on unmodified origin/main, so pre-existing and unrelated to that change; NOT on the e2e-suite skill known-residuals list):

- collection-header-kebab.spec.ts:269 "New binder inside... adds a folder row" — fails because created.parent_id is null (expected the new binder parented under the kebab-targeted collection).
- collection-header-kebab.spec.ts:309 "Move to... never offers a descendant" — fails.

Both look like either a real defect in the header kebab menu_target aiming (new-child/move dialogs acting on the wrong target) or dev-data drift. Triage: reproduce on a clean dev DB state, decide app bug vs test debris, then either fix the app path or reconcile the tests. If confirmed as an app bug, parent_id=null on "New binder inside" is a write-correctness issue (object lands at root instead of inside the collection).

Evidence added 2026-08-12 (P6-127 run): the likely root cause is TEST DEBRIS, not an app bug. There are 76 leftover zz-e2e-* collections on the Neon dev branch (many zz-e2e-mk-kid-*/zz-e2e-mv-kid-* duplicates at top level); scratchName's counter resets per file run so repeat runs regenerate identical names, and fetchTree(...).find(name===...) / labels.some(l=>l.includes(name)) then match the wrong node. collection-header-kebab failed on unmodified main with a DIFFERENT subset each of three runs (:133+:174, :269+:309, :309 alone) — classic collision nondeterminism. Triage should start with purging the zz-e2e-* debris on dev and making scratchName collision-proof (random suffix), then re-run before suspecting menu_target aiming.
